summary: Teaches instrumenting a service with Grafana Beyla (eBPF) and sending traces to Grafana Cloud via OTLP, then exploring them in Explore.

needs.description: Linux host with Docker and privileged container permission to run the sample goblog app and Beyla sidecar (--pid container, --privileged).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "A Linux system with Docker installed"; instrument-application docker run commands

needs.description: OTLP endpoint and API token generated from Grafana Cloud OpenTelemetry configure page (Generate now); user must have rights to create tokens.
Tempo traces data source (grafanacloud-traces) available in Explore.
needs.evidence: testEnvironment.datasources: tempo; explore-traces: Select a data source

needs.description: Trace data in Tempo emitted by Beyla instrumenting goblog (spans for GET /); alternative is seeding generated traces so Explore search returns a trace ID.
needs.evidence: explore-traces: "run a broad trace search ... Click a Trace ID"

reviewNotes: The path's data comes from a learner-run Docker host; E2E would need synthetic traces or a runner with Docker. Config steps (token generation) mutate the shared stack.
